title: 3 of the beautiful medieval villages in Spain
text: Alex Morales did an excellent job in leading us to 3 of the beautiful medieval villages in Spain. He introduced us informative historical and geographical background of the area and mixed it with humors. It’s a day well spent.
author: shchan19

title: Great tour with Javier!!!...
text: Great tour with Javier!!! It was a relaxing way to spend the day but still explore outside of Barcelona
author: Sarah_J

title: Like Stepping into a Fairytale!
text:
It was such a wonderful tour!

The scenery and beautiful medieval towns were absolutely breathtaking. Every place we visited felt like something out of a dream.

Our guide was also incredibly kind and friendly. The explanations were clear and easy to understand, which helped us gain a deeper appreciation of the history and culture of each town.

Thank you so much for this unforgettable experience!
author: Passenger03098058976

title: Amazing experience
text: It was amazing, the cities are beautiful, the guide Carma was wonderful!
author: MarcelaG1234

title: Great Tour.   Great Guide.
text: Guillaume was a fabulous driver and tour guide.  He knew people in the villages, which added to the experience.  His English is excellent which can be an issue for me with hearing aids.  Everything was handled with professionalism, balanced with great knowledge and humor.
author: Lynda_L

title: Amazing Medieval Towns
text: This was an amazing experience. Seeing these medieval towns was something so unique and quite special. Our tour guide, Nuria, was so pleasant and knowledgeable. One of the absolute best I have ever had. I highly recommend this tour!
author: Eric_K

title: Xavi was a tremendously informative, and engaging guide. He made history come to life and relevant. Marc: more :)
text: Very good value!! Very comfortable transport on large van, very scenic drive once you leave Barcelona. Marc could have provided more info on landscape and current day situation (he was very good and professional, and did everything to meet expectations, but it was clear that his heart wasn’t into it).
author: Sabine_S

title: Great tour! Beautiful places!
text:
The tour is completely worth it. You go to the most beautiful places with amazing views and so much history. Carme is an excellent guide and knows perfectly well what she is talking about and all the history and important facts about the places.
I highly recommend the tour.
author: claudiatJ5056CE

title: Medieval villages and beautiful countryside
text: Carmen was a wonderful guide on this lovely excursion! I highly recommend booking this tour if you love peaceful settings, beautiful countrysides, and medieval villages built on Rocky mountain sides!
author: HappyTrailsInComfort
